summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Health and Human Services to create an automated system to verify that healthcare providers are licensed and in good standing in a state before issuing them a unique health identifier.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to require verification of healthcare provider licenses before issuing unique health identifiers. This is a technical change aimed at improving the integrity of the healthcare system by ensuring providers are properly licensed, which supports the overall functioning of both public and private healthcare systems without explicitly favoring one over the other. Its impact is on the administrative efficiency and reliability of the existing system.
